label: src
quotes: Bullets are the dots that say which page a paginated strip is on, and jump to it.
Count is a figure that counts up from zero when it comes into view (or its Step lights up), in 1.4 s, with the Spanish number format.
Logo is the 540 logotype: the star and the word, one block.
MenuItem is a destination of the menu: a real link with a "current section" state.
SocialIcon is the logotype of a social network, filled and in its original canvas.
ThemeToggle switches the dark theme on and off.
Card is a title and its explanation, with an optional ordinal.
CaseItem is a portfolio case: the photo, and over it the name and the sentence, anchored at the bottom on a veil.
Footer closes the page: the brand with its tagline, the columns of links, the networks and the signature.
Grid is the twelve-column grid of the system, with the two gutters, and its two five-up layouts.
